alerts.reason: FedEx’s consolidated revenue growth slowed from 8.11% year over year in May to 5.63% in August. Higher yields, including fuel surcharges, cushioned volume declines across all transportation segments (A, E). The volume weakness accelerated in August’s final weeks (B). I forecast that pricing support will keep November-quarter revenue growth above -5.00%, but that sustained volume losses will push it to -5.00% or below in the quarter beginning December 1.
